surface_name: WP Rocket, delayed JS interaction handler
title: 't.composedPath(...)[0].getRootNode is not a function' only appears on synthetic events
symptoms: Uncaught TypeError: t.composedPath(...)[0].getRootNode is not a function
Error shows in session replay tools but real clicks work
cause: WP Rocket's delayed-JS handler calls getRootNode on the event target without checking it is a Node. An event dispatched on window has no getRootNode, so synthetic events throw; real clicks on page elements do not.
fix: Do not treat it as a broken button. Reproduce with a real click, not window.dispatchEvent.
apply: Test with a real pointer click in a browser automation tool rather than window.dispatchEvent(new Event('click'))
